description: Minimal QPE import recipe over the sealed S/T phase-estimation examples and small inverse QFT entries.

requires.name: qpe_s
requires.role: sealed minimal QPE over the canonical S gate

requires.name: qpe_t
requires.role: sealed minimal QPE over the canonical T gate

requires.name: iqft2
requires.role: small inverse Fourier component for user-side variants

requires.name: iqft3
requires.role: three-qubit inverse Fourier component for user-side variants

assembly.purpose: building externally attested small QPE variants

certificate_rule.claim: The selected qpe/s or qpe/t primitive is exact; optional IQFT refs do not certify a new user variant.

limits: User-modified QPE variants require separate circuit attestation.
Optional IQFT refs are imported attestations, not a proof of a newly assembled QPE circuit.
